description: This file contains functions for executing various user actions (like navigate, click, fill, expect, etc.) within a Playwright testing framework, including handling of action execution, expectation checks, and tracing parameters.

methods.name: runAction
methods.description: Executes a specified user action (navigate, click, fill, expect, etc.) on a page, handling instrumentation, error serialization, and secret redaction.

methods.name: innerRunAction
methods.description: Performs the core logic of executing a specific action based on its method type, such as navigation, clicking, typing, or expectations.

methods.name: runExpect
methods.description: Runs an expectation check on a page element or URL, throwing an error if the expectation does not match.

methods.name: traceParamsForAction
methods.description: Generates tracing parameters for a given action, used for logging or debugging.

methods.name: callMetadataForAction
methods.description: Creates metadata for a specific action call, including timing and parameters.
